title: maintenant
name: maintenant
description: Self-hosted monitoring for Docker, Swarm and Kubernetes: container discovery, endpoint and TLS checks, cron heartbeats, logs, image updates, alerts and a status page, in a single Go binary. Source: https://github.com/kOlapsis/maintenant

env.name: MAINTENANT_BASE_URL
env.label: Address you'll open maintenant at
env.description: The dashboard only answers to this host name (and localhost), so use the address in your browser, for example http://192.168.1.10:8080. It also builds the heartbeat ping URLs.

note: Open http://<your-host>:8080. maintenant has no login of its own, so keep the port on a trusted network or put a reverse proxy with authentication in front of it. The Docker socket is only mounted into a filtering proxy that allows read-only API calls, so maintenant cannot change your containers. /proc and /etc/os-release are bind-mounted read-only for host metrics: if your Portainer restricts bind mounts, deploy it as an admin. Data lives in the maintenant-data volume. Docs: docs.maintenant.dev
